# Clanky iOS

> Clanky iOS is the native SwiftUI client for attaching to the Eve relay, inspecting herdr state, and steering Clanky work from a phone without inventing a second API.

## Start

- [Overview](https://volpestyle.github.io/docs/clanky-ios/?doc=overview): Relay connection, operating model, Clanky contract boundary, run commands, and app structure.
